questions.q: A foreclosed property means what?
o: The owner voluntarily surrenders the property to a buyer
The property is temporarily closed for renovation by the bank
The government seizes the property due to building code violations
The bank sells the property after the borrower is unable to pay
questions.n: Foreclosure is the legal process by which a lender attempts to recover the balance of a loan from a borrower who has stopped making payments by forcing the sale of the asset used as collateral.

questions.q: Which type of foundation is generally the most ideal for coastal structures?
questions.n: Coastal areas often have loose or saturated soil, requiring loads to be transferred to deeper, more stable strata.

questions.q: Which of the following is not a cause of erosion?
questions.n: Excavation is a human activity involving the deliberate removal of soil, whereas erosion refers to natural wearing-away processes.

questions.q: Which part of the house does not necessarily need a foundation?
questions.n: Depending on local codes and design, a light porch may be supported by piers or slabs rather than a deep structural foundation required for the main house.

questions.q: Which means the mechanical removal of rock or unconsolidated material?
questions.n: Excavation is the specific construction term for digging and removing earth or rock for foundations or basements.

questions.q: A wading pool is a pool for __________.
questions.n: Wading pools are shallow pools specifically designed for the safety and recreation of small children.

questions.q: Where is the ideal location of the septic tank within the property?
questions.n: Placing it in the front yard allows for easier access by desludging trucks and closer proximity to the main public sewer line.

questions.q: What should be placed near the building?
questions.n: A motor court provides a convenient drop-off and short-term parking area immediately adjacent to the building's main entrance.

questions.q: What type of tree can be planted on the side perimeter for visual privacy?
questions.n: The Polyalthia longifolia (Indian tree) is ideal for screening because of its vertical growth habit and dense foliage.

questions.q: Which of the following is usually on the ground level and not elevated?
questions.n: A patio is by definition a paved outdoor area at ground level, whereas decks, balconies, and porches are typically elevated.

questions.q: Although not as durable as other countertop material, which of the following is famous for its elegant natural veins?
questions.n: Marble is a metamorphic rock prized for its characteristic veining, though it is softer and more porous than granite.

questions.q: Which type of stone surface finishing is most reflective?
questions.n: A polished finish uses fine abrasives to create a high-gloss, mirror-like surface that is highly reflective.

questions.q: Which flooring is the least ideal for the front porch?
questions.n: Natural wood is prone to rot, warping, and termite infestation when exposed to the elements on an outdoor porch.

questions.q: Which of the following material is the least porous?
questions.n: Porcelain tiles have a water absorption rate of less than 0.5%, making them denser and less porous than ceramic or natural stone.

questions.q: Why is it common to store extra boxes of tiles after the installation is finished?
questions.n: Keeping extra tiles ensures you have exact matches for future repairs, as tile batches (dye lots) vary and may be discontinued.

questions.q: How many CHBs are needed for the perimeter fence assuming the fence height is 1.2 meters from the ground and with 0.4m underground extension connected to its footing, with total perimeter of 200m and gate of 8m?
questions.n: Net length = 192m; Total height = 1.6m; Area = 307.2 sqm. Multiplying by the standard 12.5 pcs/sqm gives 3,840 pieces.

questions.q: How many volume of concrete is needed to raise the porch 600mm from the ground, area of porch based on the statement of the problem is 20x8? Assume solid concrete construction.
questions.n: Volume = Area x Height. 160 sqm (20 x 8) x 0.6m = 96 cubic meters.

questions.q: How many liters of priming paint is needed to cover the garage interior with area of 8x10 assuming a 6m x 2.4m garage door is installed and the ceiling height is 2.7m? Assume a 25sqm/gallon coverage of priming paint.
questions.n: Total area minus door divided by coverage gives ~6.5 gallons; converted to liters (~3.785L/gal) and adding waste results in 33 liters.

questions.q: If frog grass costs 200php/sqm, how much does it cost to cover the 50% of the rear outdoor area, outdoor area is 40x20?
questions.n: Total area = 800 sqm; 50% = 400 sqm. 400 sqm x 200 php = 80,000 php.

questions.q: How much volume is needed to be excavated to construct the outdoor pool if it is designed with 3 feet shallow end sloping to the 5 feet deep end? Provide 30% excavation allowance for the construction of walls and slabs, pool size 15mx15m.
questions.n: Average depth is 4ft (~1.22m). Volume = 15x15x1.22 = 274.5 cubic meters. Adding 30% allowance (x1.3) = 356.85, rounded to 357.

questions.q: For the project Police sub station prototype, which of the following is installed in the toilet room?
questions.n: Wainscoting provides a protective and easy-to-clean wall finish for the lower portion of the wall in high-use sanitary areas.

questions.q: Which prison wall color was believed to have a calming effect on prisoners?
questions.n: Baker-Miller Pink is a specific shade of pink used in correctional facilities based on the theory that it reduces aggressive behavior.

questions.q: What is the most ideal flooring material for the project Police sub station?
questions.n: Polished concrete is extremely durable, low-maintenance, and cost-effective for high-traffic, utilitarian buildings like substations.

questions.q: What is one the disadvantages of “zero-zero” tile installation?
questions.n: Without grout joints, tiles have no room for thermal expansion, leading to chipping, cracking, or 'buckling'.

questions.q: What do you call the lighting fixture installed on the wall and shielded by a horizontal panel?
questions.n: Valence lighting is attached to the wall and shielded by a horizontal panel, directing light both up and down.

questions.q: Which force causes a structural element to bend?
questions.n: A bending moment is a measure of the internal force that causes a structural element to bend when an external load is applied.

questions.q: Which of the following is considered a dynamic load?
questions.n: Dynamic loads are forces that change over time in magnitude or position, such as moving vehicles.

questions.q: Which structural element is typically supported by a strip footing?
questions.n: Strip footings (or continuous footings) provide a continuous line of support for load-bearing or non-load-bearing walls.

questions.q: Which structural steel connection is the most rigid?
questions.n: Moment connections are designed to resist rotation and transfer moments between members, making them highly rigid.

questions.q: What is the standard weight of a cu.m. of steel in kilograms?
questions.n: The standard density used for structural steel in engineering calculations is 7,850 kg/m³.

questions.q: What is the standard height of a toilet seat?
questions.n: Standard toilet seat heights range from 400mm to 450mm for comfort and accessibility.

questions.q: What is the ideal spacing of the vertical grilles or bars for the cells, project Police sub station?
questions.n: A 100mm (4-inch) clear spacing is standard to prevent a human head or body from passing through while maintaining visibility.

questions.q: What is the typical floor clearance of pedestal mounted toilet partitions for public use?
questions.n: A clearance of around 200mm allows for easy floor cleaning and maintenance in public restrooms.

questions.q: What is the optimum head clearance on the lower bunk bed?
questions.n: 850mm provides enough space for an adult to sit up comfortably without hitting their head on the upper bunk.

questions.q: If seating is provided along the corridor, where can it be placed?
questions.n: Placing seating on only one side maintains a clear and unobstructed path for circulation on the other side.

questions.q: The capiz shells are also known as __________ .
questions.n: Capiz shells are obtained from the windowpane oyster, often referred to as mother-of-pearl due to their iridescent quality.

questions.q: Which is the ideal wall finish for the cells?
questions.n: Painted concrete is durable, easy to sanitize, and difficult for inmates to damage compared to other materials.

questions.q: What material is the most ideal for water closets in the cells?
questions.n: Stainless steel fixtures are virtually indestructible and cannot be shattered to create weapons, unlike porcelain.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of flaming of natural stone finishes?
questions.n: Flaming creates a rough, non-slip texture and often enhances the natural color crystals within the stone.

questions.q: Which of the following is installed in the toilet room, project Police sub station?
questions.n: This repeated question emphasizes the use of wainscoting as a standard protective wall treatment in substation toilet rooms.

questions.q: According to NBCP, government buildings are exempted from ____________________________.
questions.n: Government structures must still apply for permits and follow the code, but they are exempt from paying the fees.

questions.q: According to SPP Document 206, how much is the recommended professional fee for a project manager?
questions.n: The standard professional fee for Project Management services is typically 2% to 5% of the Project Construction Cost.

questions.q: Which of the following is not chargeable to the client?
questions.n: Income tax is a personal or corporate liability of the architect and is not billed as a reimbursable expense to the client.

questions.q: How many years of practice is required as part of qualification to become an ASEAN Architect?
questions.n: The ASEAN Mutual Recognition Arrangement requires a minimum of 10 years of professional practice after graduation.

questions.q: Honorarium as a method of compensation is not applicable in the following except ___________________.
questions.n: An honorarium is appropriate for a one-time guest speaking engagement or lecture rather than ongoing professional design services.

questions.q: Structural analysis is required for the following except __________ .
o: A 20sqm detached home owners association office
questions.n: Under the NBCP, very small, single-story structures (often under 20sqm) may be exempt from formal structural analysis if they follow standard prescriptive codes.

questions.q: Which of the following doors shall not be used as an exit door?
questions.n: Fire codes generally prohibit sliding doors as main exits because they can jam and are slower to operate than swing-out doors during a panic.

questions.q: The National Building Code of the Philippines or PD 1096 was signed by which president?
questions.n: Presidential Decree No. 1096 was signed into law by President Ferdinand E. Marcos in 1977.

questions.q: A building permit expires after __________ of construction suspension.
questions.n: According to the NBCP, a permit becomes null and void if the work is suspended or abandoned for a period of 120 days.

questions.q: Who receives the appeal regarding the non-issuance of building permits?
questions.n: The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) has the authority to hear appeals regarding permit decisions.
